column2: Synexia FastCDC chunk boundaries and AllocationTracker dirty extents
column6: Caller supplies qualified extents from upstream chunker/change journal; range hashing itself never discovers dirty extents

column2: Pure Java MessageDigest SHA-256 over one seekable channel
column6: One open channel, 8192-byte scratch, O(sum selected bytes + N) compute, 4 primitive SHA-256 words per requested range
One provider stream, gaps advanced through read-through shadow/progress, output borrowed, no new VFS

column2: Commons VFS/Eclipse EFS/ZIP, database M3FS pending provider
column6: Sequential transport O(last selected end), bounded buffer; never promise provider seek/atomic snapshot or native semantics

column2: M3FS SQLite native read/readSegments and checked inode operations
column4: JNI ABI target-owned; no new symbol
column6: Native optimization only for providers with supported seek and after crossover/ABI/GC verification

column2: LeetCode bit manipulation/array, HackerRank arrays, GeeksforGeeks prefix range categories
column6: Problem-category discovery and adversarial tests only; physical offsets are authoritative

column2: M3FileDeltaLedger source/class hashes, Maven/Gradle build provenance
